parameters.query:
-- Alimenta los DOS paneles de la ventana Customizaciones en un solo viaje:
-- el catálogo (panel izquierdo, con el indicador activas/total) y las
-- implementaciones de cada evento (panel derecho).
SELECT he.id,
       he.code,
       he.name,
       he.description,
       he.module,
       he.timing,
       he.payload_schema,
       he.payload_version,
       he.is_system,
       he.is_active,
       he.created_at,
       he.updated_at,
       COALESCE(cnt.total,  0)          AS implementations_count,
       COALESCE(cnt.activas, 0)         AS active_implementations_count,
       COALESCE(impl.rows, '[]'::jsonb) AS implementations
FROM public.hook_events he
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hr.is_active) AS activas
    FROM public.hook_registry hr
    WHERE hr.event_code = he.code
) cnt ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.seq, x.created_at) AS rows
    FROM (
        SELECT hr.id, hr.event_code, hr.name, hr.description, hr.handler_type,
               hr.handler_ref, hr.seq, hr.mode, hr.on_error, hr.timeout_ms,
               hr.config, hr.log_enabled, hr.is_active,
               hr.created_at, hr.updated_at,
               u.name AS created_by_name,
               l.last_executed_at,
               l.last_status
        FROM public.hook_registry hr
        LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id = hr.created_by
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT el.executed_at AS last_executed_at, el.status AS last_status
            FROM public.hook_execution_log el
            WHERE el.registry_id = hr.id
            ORDER BY el.executed_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) l ON true
        WHERE hr.event_code = he.code
    ) x
) impl ON true
WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR $1 = '' OR he.module = $1::text)
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR $2 = ''
       OR he.code ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
       OR he.name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
ORDER BY he.module ASC, he.code ASC

meta.notes:
CONFIGURACIÓN REQUERIDA:
1. Credencial 'Postgres' en 'Buscar Eventos' (reemplaza POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID).
2. Credencial 'JWT Auth account' en el Webhook (ya referenciada por id).
3. Generar un webhookId nuevo (reemplaza REEMPLAZAR-POR-UUID-NUEVO) o dejar que
   n8n lo genere al importar.
4. Activar el workflow.

RUTA: GET https://<tu-n8n>/webhook/hooks/events
AUTENTICACIÓN: JWT (header Authorization: Bearer <token>).
PERMISO EN EL FRONTEND: CUSTOMIZATIONS_VIEW_LIST.

QUERY PARAMS (ambos opcionales):
  module → filtra por módulo ('billing', 'appointments', 'core'…)
  search → busca en code y name

RESPUESTA: array de eventos del catálogo, cada uno con el conteo de
implementaciones y el array completo de las mismas, para alimentar los dos
paneles de la ventana en un solo viaje.

[
  {
    "id": "...", "code": "invoice.after_upsert", "name": "...",
    "module": "billing", "timing": "after", "payload_schema": { },
    "payload_version": 1, "is_system": true, "is_active": true,
    "implementations_count": 1, "active_implementations_count": 1,
    "implementations": [
      { "id": "...", "name": "Recalcular descuentos", "handler_ref": "...",
        "seq": 100, "mode": "sync", "on_error": "ignore", "is_active": true,
        "last_executed_at": "...", "last_status": "success" }
    ]
  }
]
